title: Payer Requirements Matrix: Prior Authorization by Service Class and Payer Class
content:
Whether a Laboratory Test Orders accession billed to insurance needs prior authorization depends on its service class and on the payer class of the coverage billed. The matrix gives the flag for each class.

| Service class | Commercial (In-Network and Out-of-Network Plans) | Medicare Advantage Plan (organization determination) | Medicaid Managed Care Plan | TRICARE Prime and Select |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Routine Clinical Testing | Not required | Not required | Not required | Not required |
| Specialty Clinical Testing | Not required | Not required | Not required | Not required |
| Esoteric Reference Testing | Not required | Not required | Not required | Not required |
| Molecular Infectious Disease Testing | Not required | Not required | Not required | Not required |
| Clinical Toxicology Testing | Not required | Not required | **Required** | Not required |
| Anatomic Pathology & Cytology | Not required | Not required | Not required | Not required |
| Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing | **Required** | **Required** | **Required** | **Required** |

## Reading the matrix

- Original Medicare Part B and Medicare Supplement Plan have no column: neither ever requires prior authorization.
- Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing requires prior authorization for every payer class shown. Clinical Toxicology Testing requires it only for Medicaid Managed Care Plan coverage. No other class requires it for any payer class.

| Hypothetical accession | Prior authorization required? |
|---|---|
| Clinical Toxicology Testing billed to a Medicaid Managed Care Plan | Yes |
| Clinical Toxicology Testing billed to a Commercial In-Network Plan | No |
| Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing billed to TRICARE Prime and Select | Yes |
| Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing billed to Original Medicare Part B | No |
